edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “Agreement”) is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”) and is effective on the date of the last signature below (the “Effective Date”). Each Party may act as a disclosing Party or a receiving Party.

1. PURPOSE AND CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The Parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party to the other Party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure, including analyses reflecting that information. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes public without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without confidentiality restrictions before disclosure; (c) is lawfully obtained from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

2. MUTUAL OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the Parties’ mutual promises, each receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality duties at least as protective as this Agreement; the receiving Party is responsible for their compliance. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving Party may disclose only what is legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall give prompt advance notice and reasonable assistance, at the disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving Party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, except for copies required by law or professional retention obligations and routine backup copies not reasonably accessible in ordinary operations, all of which remain subject to this Agreement. No intellectual property rights are granted except the limited right to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.

3. TERM AND SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier by either Party on written notice. The receiving Party’s confidentiality and restricted-use obligations survive for three years after termination or expiration; for Confidential Information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as it remains a trade secret. Neither Party is required to disclose information or enter into any transaction, and any transaction requires a separate definitive written agreement.

4. REMEDIES. A Party may seek injunctive relief for an actual or threatened breach, subject to applicable law and the court’s discretion, in addition to damages and other available remedies. This Agreement does not establish an automatic entitlement to injunctive relief or waive applicable requirements for obtaining such relief.

The Parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party to the other Party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure, including analyses reflecting that information. Confidential Information also includes the existence and status of discussions concerning the Purpose and the terms of any proposed transaction. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving Party can demonstrate: (a) is or becomes public without breach of this Agreement; (b) was lawfully known to it without confidentiality restrictions before disclosure; (c) is lawfully obtained from a third party without a duty of confidentiality; or (d) is independently developed without use of the Confidential Information.

2. MUTUAL OBLIGATIONS. In consideration of the Parties’ mutual promises, each receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality duties at least as protective as this Agreement; the receiving Party is responsible for their compliance. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving Party may disclose only what is legally required and, to the extent legally permitted, shall give prompt advance notice and reasonable assistance, at the disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, including copies and analyses reflecting it, and provide written certification by an authorized representative of its compliance. The receiving Party may retain copies required by law or professional retention obligations and routine backup copies not reasonably accessible in ordinary operations. All retained copies remain subject to this Agreement and may be accessed or used only for legal or compliance purposes, not for business purposes; backup copies shall not be restored except as necessary for legal or compliance purposes or disaster recovery, and any restored copies shall remain subject to these restrictions. No intellectual property rights are granted except the limited right to use Confidential Information for the Purpose.

3. TERM AND SURVIVAL. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier by either Party on written notice. The receiving Party’s confidentiality and restricted-use obligations survive for five years after termination or expiration; for Confidential Information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those obligations continue for as long as it remains a trade secret. Notwithstanding the foregoing, retained copies under Section 2 remain subject to its confidentiality and access and use restrictions for so long as retained. Neither Party is required to disclose information or enter into any transaction, and any transaction requires a separate definitive written agreement.

5. GOVERNING LAW AND FORUM. This Agreement and disputes arising out of or relating to it shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws rules. Each Party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts located in New York County, New York, and the federal courts located in Manhattan, New York, for such disputes, and waives objections based on venue or forum non conveniens.

6. NOTICES. Notices and requests under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by personal delivery, nationally recognized overnight courier, or email to the applicable contact below, as updated by written notice. Personal delivery is effective upon receipt; courier delivery is effective upon documented delivery; email is effective upon acknowledgment of receipt by the recipient, excluding automated replies. Notices received outside 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. on a business day at the recipient’s location are effective on the next business day. “Business day” excludes Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays at the recipient’s location.
